lcc_original: 當時全地在上帝面前都敗壞了：全地滿了強暴。
notes: 世界 (UNV) → 全地 (LCC): both map to WH0776 (אֶרֶץ, earth/land); both occurrences annotated
神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): both map to WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים)
LCC 當時 ('at that time') has no UNV/SN counterpart — left unannotated
LCC 都 (adverb 'all') has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
Chinese aspect particles 了 (×2) have no Hebrew equivalents — SN tags placed immediately after verb roots 敗壞 and 滿, before 了
